title: Mesh to editable CAD solids
body: I cannot draw CAD from scratch, but I can usually find a downloaded mesh that is close to the part I need. So I built a pipeline that turns that mesh into something I can edit: AI agents rebuild it as a real solid, and I take my changes from there, resizing it, drilling holes, adding a bracket. A mesh goes in, and STEP and 3MF come out. It runs live in a browser viewer.

Every rebuild is checked against the original mesh. On my own test parts the rebuilt solid matches the original 99.6%, where a published research method reaches 84.8%. One example is a 58-part rack assembly rebuilt from downloaded meshes, with every operation recorded in a log next to the model.
